library(shiny)
# Define the function to convert a zip code to a temperature
function convertTemp(zip) {
  # Use the `lookup` function to find the temperature for the given zip code
  temp = lookup(zip, "zip_to_temp")

  # Return the temperature
  return(temp)
}

# Define the UI for the app
ui = fluidPage(
  # Define the title for the app
  titlePanel(
    # Add a slider to select the zip code
    sliderInput(
      input = "zip",
      label = "Zip Code",
      min = 1,
      max = 100,
      value = 1
    )
  ),
  # Define the plot to visualize the temperature
  plotOutput()
)

# Define the server function
server = function(input, output) {
  # Call the `convertTemp` function to get the temperature
  temp = convertTemp(input$zip)

  # Print the temperature
  output$plot = renderPlot({
    # Create a line plot of the temperature
    lineplot(x = 1:100, y = temp, color = input$zip)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
